lines.t: He stepped down, Word made flesh in the filth of the block,
Man of Sorrows, eyes on fire, time‑bomb clock.
Friend of the broken, but the system marked Him a threat,
Priests plotting murder just to keep their respect.The adversary flashed the kingdoms, neon on demand,
He chose a splintered tree and a blood‑soaked hand.
Lamb led silent, no pact, no truce,
World’s guilt hanging like a live‑wired noose.Two thousand years later, wolves flex in white suits,
Prosperity in their teeth, poison in their roots.
Selling plastic heaven while the poor stay crushed,
Stage lights thunder, but the Spirit’s been hushed.
This ain’t that soft fake messiah that your idols preach,
This is YahuShua, Lion roaring, out of reach.
Terror of the wicked when the sky rips like a knife,
Refuge for the broken who surrender their life.Let His Name hit hard, 808s in your chest,
Graves for the rebels, but the weary find rest.
No smoke‑filled myth where the tortured never tire,
Just the second death in the Lake of Fire.
They market a gospel with no awe, no fear,
No Judgment Seat, no Law drawing near.
They cancel repentance, call rebellion “grace,”
While the sheep starve thin with a smile on their face.They say, “Pray this once and you’re set for good,”
But refuse to turn from what He said no man should.
They trample His sacrifice, cheapen His blood,
Building ivory towers that’ll drown in the flood.The Trumpet is screaming, the Letters are read,
The King stands ready with a crown and dread.
He’s coming with a sword that divides bone and soul,
Either be made whole or be ripped from the roll.
He’s gonna grip the plates till the coastlines slide,
Whole cities swallowed when the sea runs high.
Skylines tumble like chalk in His hand,
Power grids die in the pride of the land.Hail mixed with fire, blood in the rain,
Sirens and smoke in a furnace of pain.
Pestilence in the water, famine in the streets,
Concrete kingdoms buckling under His feet.Mother‑nation shaking, towers bent low,
Streets split open where the rich once glowed.
Megachurch marble, stained‑glass high,
But one quake, one plague and your steeples all die.Nature turned enemy, winds like war,
Rivers run red where the little ones poured.
Every temple of idols, every tower of pride,
One breath from His nostrils and they all capsize.
This ain’t that tame plastic savior they admire,
This is YahuShua, eyes a blazing fire.
Graves for the body, then the court at the end,
Either life in His Kingdom or no breath again.Let His Name shake pews, crack your desire,
Gehenna for rebellion, Lake of Fire for the liar.
No halfway covenant, no lukewarm choir,
Be wheat on His threshing floor or fuel for the pyre.
Choose this day whom you serve, no spin,
Cling to your idols or be crucified with Him.
Count the cost, drop your crown, let your ego die,
Better lose your life now than be erased with a sigh.All your lust, all your pride, every hidden scheme,
Burn it now on the altar or be lost like a dream.
Flesh to the dust and the bones to the ground,
Then the books get opened when the King comes down.
YahuShua HaMashiach, double‑edged Word,
Every mask ripped off, every motive heard.
No more stage, no more script, no more choir for hire,
Just the Holy One deciding who escapes the fire.This is the line in the sand, the dividing sword,
No middle lane when you stand before The Lord.
Either hidden in His wounds when the stars expire,
Or a name never spoken from the Lake of Fire.
